content.text:
DESeq2 finished. Here is the complete result table (8 of 8 genes, output not truncated).

## What I did

- Found `counts.csv` as hid 7 (HDA `f9cad7b01a47213568200b5389b2bfb8`) in the Galaxy history **"platform-benchmark fixtures"** (`bbd44e69cb8906b597074ed46423d4af`) on usegalaxy.org. It is 8 genes × 4 samples: `control_1, control_2, treated_1, treated_2`.
- Converted CSV→tabular (`csv_to_tabular`, hid 31), then split into one 2-column count file per sample with `Cut1`.

I re-cut each file from a distinct parent so the names became unique (hid 38–41), then reran.
